# Cloudhost

> Cloudhost is a cloud platform for building, deploying, and scaling web applications.

Use this index to find machine-readable documentation and platform resources.

## When to use Cloudhost

- Deploy and scale web applications from a Git repository or the CLI.
- Automate projects, deployments and domains through the REST API.

## How agents should use Cloudhost

- For research, fetch the Markdown documentation indexes below.
- For REST API calls, read the OpenAPI description first.

## Agent setup

- [Set up Cloudhost for your coding agent](https://cloudhost.test/get-started.md): Install the CLI and connect MCP.
- [Getting started](https://cloudhost.test/docs/getting-started.md?from=llms-txt): Deploy your first project.

## Documentation

- [Docs index](https://cloudhost.test/docs/llms.txt): Every documentation page as Markdown
- [REST API](https://cloudhost.test/docs/rest-api.md): Endpoints and authentication
